<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Misty Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5402) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

**Frequency**
once per minute

**Trigger**
You transform due to a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect.

</column>

---

Wild mists cover your form. You create a hazy cloud in a 5-foot burst centered on one corner of your space. If your new form is Large or larger, the cloud covers your entire space instead. All creatures within the area are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62), and all others are concealed to them. The cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn but is immediately dispersed by a strong wind.
name: Misty Transformation
